settings.languageHelp: Choose how the app speaks to you. "System" follows your phone's language.

plus.title: MyZolve Connect Plus
plus.thanksForSupporting: Thanks for being a Plus member. Your support keeps Connect warm and ad-free for the people who keep showing up.
plus.noOwnedCircles: You're not the owner of any circle yet. Create a circle first, then come back here to designate it as your family circle.
plus.familyCap: Plus is gifted to the first {{cap}} active members (oldest joiners first). Members beyond that won't get Plus automatically.
plus.freePlanBody: Plus unlocks bigger circles, richer moments, and tools made for the people who keep showing up.
plus.gifterBody: You have Plus through their family plan. It stays active as long as their subscription does.
plus.graceWarning: Heads up: their subscription has lapsed. Your gifted Plus will end on {{date}} unless they renew.
plus.noPurchasesBody: We couldn't find an active Plus subscription on this Apple ID.
plus.couldntOpenSubsBody: Open the App Store app, tap your profile, then Subscriptions.
plus.familyPlanBody: Up to {{cap}} people in your family circle get Plus while your subscription is active.
plus.switchFamilyHint: Switch to a family plan to share Plus with up to 6 people in one of your circles.

wrapup.shortLookBack: A short look back at the care you shared.
wrapup.privacyNote: We collect this quietly in the background — only you can see it. You can turn weekly or monthly wrap-ups off anytime in Settings.
